description: Na₂UTeO₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ama2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.89 Å. U is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.58 Å. Te is bonded to six O atoms to form TeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 33°. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-1.99 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one U atom to form distorted ONa₃U tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃U tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₂UTe trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂UTe trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one U, and one Te atom to form distorted ONa₂UTe trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃U tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂UTe trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃U tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂UTe trigonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one U, and two equivalent Te atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one U, and one Te atom.
